memory_candidates.content: A task whose deliverable IS a shared, wholesale-regenerated index file (specs/state.json, specs/TODO.md) cannot stage its commits free of concurrent siblings' rows -- the contamination is structural, not a staging mistake. The sanctioned handling is a pair: every read-modify-write goes through .claude/scripts/state-write.sh (fail-closed specs/.scope-lock mutex, private mktemp staging; never a hand-rolled 'jq > tmp && mv', never Edit/Write on state.json), and every commit that stages specs/state.json or specs/TODO.md passes --honest-index-rows <task> to git-commit-scoped.sh, which appends an 'Also carries current index rows for tasks: ...' body line. Per git-staging-scope.md that flag is REQUIRED at every such site, not optional. Corollary for planning: sequence all phases of such a task rather than waving them in parallel, so each commit's diff stays attributable to one named repair.
